policy: Same strict policy as v0.1's media-manifest.json: an item is only eligible for automatic ingestion once ALL three are true - (1) the source explicitly permits editorial reuse, (2) the exact required credit/photographer is known, (3) the intended use complies with the source's terms. None of the candidates below currently satisfy all three with full confidence, so every item is 'permission_required' or 'placeholder_only'. See README.md for the reasoning per source.
